name: Todochy
author: RibatTRW
description: Minimal Pomodoro timer with a task list and a daily streak for the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Pomodoro timer with a flat task list and a day-based streak

schema.label: Short break minutes
schema.description: Length of a break after a normal work block.

schema.label: Long break minutes
schema.description: Length of the break that follows a full set of work blocks.

schema.label: Work blocks per long break
schema.description: How many work blocks are completed before a long break.

schema.label: Alarm sounds
schema.description: Play an alarm when a work block ends and when a task is marked complete.

schema.label: Sound when a work block ends
schema.description: Played when a work block runs out and a break begins.

schema.label: Sound when a task is completed
schema.description: Played when the current task is marked complete in the panel.

schema.label: Same sound for both events
schema.description: Play the block-end sound when a task is completed too.

schema.label: Times each alarm plays
schema.description: How many times one alarm is heard, with a short gap between plays.

schema.label: Alarm volume
schema.description: Volume of the alarm, 0 to 100. Does not change the system volume.
